input.summary: Tungabhadra Actives LLP (V02). Sent quotation and Niacinamide COA (dated 2026-03-10, now over 6 months old) in reply to RFx KPC-2026-014. Quote mentions a footnote we have not yet clarified. Open: RM-001 quoted per drum with no net weight and MOQ 2 drum, both need kg conversion; RM-003 COA stale, needs a fresh one. Questionnaire gaps not yet asked: Q5 (COA per line, knockout), Q9 (SDS and leave-on suitability, knockout), Q6, Q8. Peptide cold-zone constraints were stated in our outbound email.

input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Quotation follow-up, clarifications and documents required
input.body:
Dear Anand,

Thank you for your quotation and the Niacinamide COA for RFx KPC-2026-014. We need the following before we can evaluate your offer.

Propanediol (RM-001)
1. Your quotation is per drum with no net weight. Please state the net weight of one drum in kg.
2. Your MOQ is 2 drums. Please confirm the MOQ in kg (2 drums x net weight per drum).

Niacinamide (RM-003)
3. The COA you sent is dated 10 March 2026, which is more than 6 months old. Please provide a COA for a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

Mandatory questionnaire
4. Provide a COA from a recent batch for each line in this RFx (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
5. Provide the Safety Data Sheet for each line and confirm each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
6. State your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold with their expiry dates.
7. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please also clarify the footnote in your quotation, as it affects the terms we are evaluating.

Please reply with these answers in one message. Thank you.

Regards,
Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
